title: lathyrus luteus subsp. aureus
intro: Lathyrus luteus subsp. aureus, commonly known as the golden pea or golden lathyris, is a plant species of the genus Lathyrus that belongs to the legume family, Fabaceae. It is a perennial legume with yellow flowers, native to the Mediterranean region. The golden pea has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus subsp. aureus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
